note: CORRECTION. The first 2026-09-02 pass spent its picks on speculative dynasty-style darts (Devaughn Vele, Justice Hill, Darren Waller, Sione Vaki, Barion Brown) that its own my_team_impact field admitted don't fit my roster, and it never cross-checked them against my actual droppable bench piece. Re-running the pool against Sleeper's live 2026 season projections (re-pulled 2026-09-02) and my own bench floor: Kayshon Boutte at 104.7 projected points is the one genuinely droppable bench spot (Odunze 173.9, Ferguson 124.8, Johnston 134.9 and Washington 89.5-as-Jeanty's-handcuff are all keepers). Against that bar, Jalen Coker (135.9) and Khalil Shakir (135.2) from the Sept 1 board remain live and unclaimed, and one new name clears it: Chris Rodriguez Jr, confirmed a co-starter with my own Bhayshul Tuten in Jacksonville's backfield after a two-year, 10-million-dollar deal (Yahoo Sports depth-chart piece, 2026 camp). He projects 125.0 points, the best available RB in the entire pool by a wide margin over Justice Hill (55.7) and everything else checked today (Zavion Thomas 47.2, Caleb Douglas 77.8, Kaelon Black 39.3, Devaughn Vele 89.6, Emari Demercado 30.8, George Holani 23.2, Sione Vaki 3.0, Odell Beckham 23.0). Devaughn Vele (89.6) and Darren Waller (99.1) both fall below the Boutte bar and are correctly re-ranked avoid/watch rather than value. Also confirmed via the week-1 league transaction log: every add so far (including my own Boutte pickup and Stipe's Tuesday-processed Saylors add) processed with an empty waiver_budget, so the market is still uncontested free-agent claims, not a priced auction, even though Sept 1 fell on a Tuesday. Rival-need read: bwalsh89 carries only three rostered running backs (Skattebo, Harvey, Chase Brown), the league's thinnest RB bench, real structural pressure on Rodriguez specifically.

targets.why: NEW. Signed a two-year, 10-million-dollar deal with Jacksonville in March 2026 after Travis Etienne's departure; the Jaguars' 2026 training-camp depth chart lists him a confirmed co-starter alongside my own Bhayshul Tuten, with coach Liam Coen on record saying the touch split 'is going to have to be a little bit more by committee.'

On raw points alone he also clears Boutte by +20.3, second only to Coker/Shakir among the three real options for my one open spot.

targets.competition: bwalsh89 carries only three rostered running backs (Skattebo, Harvey, Chase Brown), the league's thinnest RB bench, and is the one owner with a structural reason to claim any decent free-agent back on sight.
